name: Button
description: Primary, secondary, text, hover, pressed, focus and disabled. One main action; 44px minimum target.

name: Logo
description: Supplied raster artwork; black plate; preserve proportions and 10% clear space. Full artwork itself at least 120px for production.

name: Icon
description: 16 original simple line icons. 24px viewBox, 2px stroke; decorative icons hidden from assistive technology.

name: Badge
description: Format, registration status and sponsor-tier variants. Meaning is written in words.

name: EventDetails
description: Date, venue, format, fee and authoritative action together. Copy is drawn from the September 21 project brief.

name: EventDate
description: Compact social and UI date block; never infer date from photography.

name: RegistrationAction
description: Link variant in production after checkout route is confirmed. This specimen sends no registration.

name: Field
description: Visible label, email keyboard, autocomplete and helper text.

name: FieldError
description: Error names the fix and is connected with aria-describedby; no color-only signal.

name: Select
description: Native select, keyboard accessible. Options are inquiry categories, not promised services.

name: Checkbox
description: Optional consent is unchecked by default; connected to a real policy before launch.

name: Textarea
description: Plain language prompt and generous input area.

name: Alert
description: Calm logistics alert; requires timestamp and authoritative source.

name: StatusMessage
description: Success/info use blue; errors use action red. Icon and text distinguish meaning.

name: ProductionWarning
description: Visible authoring placeholder; replace only after checking the underlying fact.

name: Navigation
description: Responsive navigation specimen. Final information architecture remains proposed.

name: Footer
description: Compact, standard and expanded variants; no invented social handles.

name: CTABand
description: Dark band, single red action and a restrained blue edge.

name: EventCard
description: Event summary card with date and place visible before the action.

name: Schedule
description: Chronological timeline; no invented check-in times.

name: NewPlayerGuide
description: Helpful steps without promising loaners, coaching or beginner divisions.

name: VenueCard
description: Venue is labeled separately from the mailing location.

name: BeneficiaryCard
description: Neutral logo slot and relationship statement; no assumed endorsement.

name: SponsorGrid
description: Equal visual weight within each confirmed tier. Preserve each supplied logo.

name: SponsorTier
description: Tier benefits and price remain editable until defined.

name: DonationAllocation
description: Allocation and transfer totals require records. No implied percentage split.

name: DonationFAQ
description: Native disclosure controls; donation answers need operational confirmation.

name: VolunteerCard
description: Recruitment CTA with clear role and date fields.

name: ResourceCard
description: Keep resource information separate from fundraising; verify provider details.

name: MerchandiseCard
description: Product images must be real product assets or labeled mockups.

name: Quote
description: Never fabricate testimony or attribution.

name: Review
description: Rating appears only if the source supplies it.

name: KPI
description: One, two, three and four metric variants. Empty data stays a placeholder.

name: KPIGrid
description: Responsive metric group with independent source fields.

name: Citation
description: Readable evidence line. Required on statistics and researched content.

name: PhotoCaption
description: Provenance and consent metadata stay attached to assets.

name: PhotoGallery
description: Authentic photo grid; individual caption and alt text before publication.

name: Comparison
description: Compare the same dimensions; use labels rather than red/blue alone.

name: Checklist
description: Checklist supports short, long, process and review variants.

name: CarouselFooter
description: Persistent page numbering and optional swipe cue; real sequence count.

name: ImageContainer
description: Full bleed, framed, rounded, split, portrait, product and screenshot slots; do not invent device or product evidence.

name: BrowserFrame
description: Neutral browser frame for an actual site capture; no fabricated interface proof.

name: EmptyState
description: Honest empty state for unpopulated reporting.

name: Progress
description: No fabricated filled portion; determinate state requires numerator and denominator.

name: ContactCard
description: Contact card using client-provided details.
